Summary

Below is a summary of what we found when checking the nylgmadlaunchprod report suite looking at data from 2023-10-01 to 2023-12-31.

Note: The raw data for everything that follows is available in this Google Sheet.

When it comes to traffic sources:

  • There were 1,509 unique values for the campaign variable (tracking code).
  • The campaign variable (tracking code) has 5 classifications configured.
  • Of those, 5 of the classifications are being populated with values.

Of the 8 marketing channels that recorded visits:

  • 2 channels each account for less than 1% of total visits to the site.
  • Internal appears as a marketing channel, but it is less than 1% of total traffic, so this is of low concern.
